newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank chief says stock undervalued.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank chief says stock undervalued.

text.p: Commerzbank AG chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen said on Thursday that he considered shares in the German bank to be comparatively undervalued on the basis of its price-earnings ratio.
Kohlhaussen noted that the Commerzbank share had, for other reasons, been rising strongly since he made similar comments last November.
"But that is not enough," he told journalists at a reception, referring to the share gain since his earlier comments.
Kohlhaussen declined to comment on the takeover rumours which have largely been responsible for the gains in Commerzbank's share price in recent months.
He said, however, that the bank was still holding talks with unnamed parties on a possible acquisition in the area of asset management.
Kohlhaussen added that the bank had enough capital to fulfil its ambitions and that he saw no need for a capital increase.
"We may need to do something to improve the returns on that capital but I think it (the capital) is enough," he said.
